H8400.et: from (01101) in the original sense of flowing
H8400.def: from «01101» in the original sense of flowing: a cataract (in the eye):--blemish.

H8401.def: probably from «01129»; properly, material, i.e. (specifically) refuse haum or stalks of grain (as chopped in threshing and used for fodder):--chaff, straw, stubble.

H8403.def: from «01129»; structure; by implication, a model, resemblance:--figure, form, likeness, pattern, similitude.

H8404.def: from «01197»; burning; Taberah, a place in the Desert:--Taberah.

H8405.def: from the same as «0948»; whiteness; Tebets, a place in Palestine:--Thebez.

H8407.def: or Tiglath Plecer {tig- lath pel-eh-ser}; or Tilgath Pilnlecer {til-gath' pil-neh-eh'-ser} or Tilgath Pilnecer {til-gath' pil-neh'-ser}; of foreign derivation; Tiglath- Pileser or Tilgath-pilneser, an Assyr. king:--Tiglath-pileser, Tilgath- pilneser.

H8410.def: apparently from «01725»; enduring; a species of hard-wood or lasting tree (perhaps oak):--pine (tree).

H8411.et: from (01753) in the original sense of enduring
H8411.def: (Aramaic) from «01753» in the original sense of enduring; permanence, i.e. (adverb) constantly:--continually.

H8412.def: or Tammor (1 Kings 9:18) {tam-more'}; apparently from «08558»; palm-city; Tadmor, a place near Palestine:--Tadmor.

H8413.def: perhaps from «01763»; fearfulness; Tidal, a Canaanite:--Tidal.

H8414.et: from an unused root meaning to lie waste
H8414.def: from an unused root meaning to lie waste; a desolation (of surface), i.e. desert; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain:--confusion, empty place, without form, nothing, (thing of) nought, vain, vanity, waste, wilderness.

H8415.def: or thom {teh-home'}; (usually feminine) from «01949»; an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean water-supply):--deep (place), depth.

H8417.et: from an unused noun (apparently from (01984)) meaning bluster
H8417.def: feminine of an unused noun (apparently from «01984») meaning bluster; braggadocio, i.e. (by implication) fatuity:--folly.

H8419.def: from «02015»; a perversity or fraud:--(very) froward(-ness, thing), perverse thing.

H8420.def: from «08427»; a mark; by implication, a signature:--desire, mark.

H8421.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07725», to come back; specifically (transitive and ellip.) to reply:--answer, restore, return (an answer).

H8422.def: or Tubal {too-bal'}; probably of foreign derivation; Tubal, a postdiluvian patriarch and his posterity:--Tubal.

H8423.def: apparently from «02986» (compare «02981») and «07014»; offspring of Cain; Tubal-Kajin, an antidiluvian patriarch:--Tubal-cain.

H8424.def: from «03013»; depression (of spirits); concretely a grief:--heaviness, sorrow.

H8425.def: or Togarmah {to-gar-maw'}; probably of foreign derivation; Togarmah, a son of Gomer and his posterity:--Togarmah.

H8426.def: from «03034»; properly, an extension of the hand, i.e. (by implication) avowal, or (usually) adoration; specifically, a choir of worshippers:--confession, (sacrifice of) praise, thanks(-giving, offering).

H8427.def: a primitive root; to mark out, i.e. (primitive) scratch or (definite) imprint:--scrabble, set (a mark).

H8428.et: a primitive root [or perhaps ident with (08427) through a similar idea from scraping to pieces]
H8428.def: a primitive root (or perhaps ident. with «08427» through a similar idea from scraping to pieces); to grieve:--limit (by confusion with «08427»).

H8429.et: corresponding to (08539) or perhaps to (07582) through the idea of sweeping to ruin [compare (08428)]
H8429.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «08539» or perhaps to «07582» through the idea of sweeping to ruin (compare «08428»); to amaze, i.e. (reflex. by implication) take alarm:--be astonied.

H8430.et: from an unused root meaning to depress
H8430.def: from an unused root meaning to depress; humble; Toach, an Israelite:--Toah.

H8432.et: from an unused root meaning to sever
H8432.def: from an unused root meaning to sever; a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre:--among(-st), × between, half, × (there- ,where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), × out (of), × through, × with(-in).

H8433.def: and towkachath {to-kakh'-ath}; from «03198»; chastisement; figuratively (by words) correction, refutation, proof (even in defence):--argument, × chastened, correction, reasoning, rebuke, reproof, × be (often) reproved.

H8434.def: from «03205»; posterity; Tolad, a place in Palestine:--Tolad. Compare «0513».

H8435.def: or toldah {to-led-aw'}; from «03205»; (plural only) descent, i.e. family; (figuratively) history:--birth, generations.

H8436.def: from «08524»; suspension; Tulon, an Israelite:--Tilon (from the margin).

H8437.def: from «03213»; causing to howl, i.e. an oppressor:--that wasted.

H8438.def: and (feminine) towleoah {to-lay-aw'}; or towla ath {to-lah'-ath}; or tolaiath {to-lah'-ath}; from «03216»; a maggot (as voracious); specifically (often with ellipsis of «08144») the crimson-grub, but used only (in this connection) of the color from it, and cloths dyed therewith:--crimson, scarlet, worm.

H8439.def: the same as «08438»; worm; Tola, the name of two Israelites:--Tola.

H8440.def: patronymically from «08439»; a Tolaite (collectively) or descendants of Tola:--Tolaites.

H8441.def: or tonebah {to-ay-baw'}; feminine active participle of «08581»; properly, something disgusting (morally), i.e. (as noun) an abhorrence; especially idolatry or (concretely) an idol:-- abominable (custom, thing), abomination.

H8442.def: feminine active participle of «08582»; mistake, i.e. (morally) impiety, or (political) injury:--error, hinder.

H8443.def: from «03286»; (only in plural collective) weariness, i.e. (by implication) toil (treasure so obtained) or speed:--plenty, strength.

H8444.def: or totsaah {to-tsaw-aw'}; from «03318»; (only in plural collective) exit, i.e. (geographical) boundary, or (figuratively) deliverance, (actively) source:--border(-s), going(-s) forth (out), issues, outgoings.

H8445.def: from the same as «03349»; obedience; Tokahath, an Israelite:--Tikvath (by correction for «08616»).

H8446.def: a primitive root; to meander (causatively, guide) about, especially for trade or reconnoitring:--chap(-man), sent to descry, be excellent, merchant(-man), search (out), seek, (e-)spy (out).

H8447.def: or tor {tore}; from «08446»; a succession, i.e. a string or (abstractly) order:--border, row, turn.

H8448.def: probably the same as «08447»; a manner (as a sort of turn):--estate.

H8449.def: or tor {tore}; probably the same as «08447»; a ring-dove, often (figuratively) as a term of endearment:--(turtle) dove.

H8450.def: (Aramaic) corresponding (by permutation) to «07794»; a bull:--bullock, ox.

H8451.def: or torah {to-raw'}; from «03384»; a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch:--law.

H8453.def: or toshab (1 Kings 17:1) {to-shawb'}; from «03427»; a dweller (but not outlandish («05237»)); especially (as distinguished from a native citizen (active participle of «03427») and a temporary inmate («01616») or mere lodger («03885»)) resident alien:--foreigner, inhabitant, sojourner, stranger.

H8454.et: from an unused root probably meaning to substantiate
H8454.def: or tushiyah { too-shee-yaw'}; from an unused root probably meaning to substantiate; support or (by implication) ability, i.e. (direct) help, (in purpose) an undertaking, (intellectual) understanding:--enterprise, that which (thing as it) is, substance, (sound) wisdom, working.

H8455.et: from an unused root meaning to smite
H8455.def: from an unused root meaning to smite; a club:--darts.

H8456.def: a primitive root; to lop off:--cut down.

H8457.def: or taznuth {taz-nooth'}; from «02181»; harlotry, i.e. (figuratively) idolatry:--fornication, whoredom.

H8458.def: or tachbuwlah {takh-boo-law'}; from «02254» as denominative from «02256»; (only in plural) properly, steerage (as a management of ropes), i.e. (figuratively) guidance or (by implication) a plan:--good advice, (wise) counsels.

H8459.et: from an unused root meaning to depress
H8459.def: from an unused root meaning to depress; abasement; Tochu, an Israelite:--Tohu.

H8461.def: probably for «02453»; sagacious; Tachkemoni, an Israelite:--Tachmonite.

H8462.et: from (02490) in the sense of opening
H8462.def: from «02490» in the sense of opening; a commencement; rel. original (adverb, -ly):--begin(-ning), first (time).

H8463.def: or tachalui {takh-al-oo'}; from «02456»; a malady:--disease, × grievous, (that are) sick(-ness).

H8464.def: from «02554»; a species of unclean bird (from its violence), perhaps an owl:--night hawk.

H8465.def: probably from «02583»; station; Tachan, the name of two Israelites:--Tahan.

H8467.def: from «02603»; graciousness; causatively, entreaty:--favour, grace, supplication.

H8468.def: the same as «08467»; Techinnah, an Israelite:--Tehinnah.

H8469.def: or (feminine) tachanuwnah {takh-an-oo-naw'}; from «02603»; earnest prayer:--intreaty, supplication.

H8470.def: patronymically from «08465»; a Tachanite (collectively) or descendants of Tachan:--Tahanites.

H8471.def: or Tchaphnchec (Ezek. 30:18) {tekh- af-nekh-ace'}; or Tachpnec (Jeremiah 2:16) {takh-pen-ace'}; of Egyptian derivation; Tachpanches, Techaphneches or Tachpenes, a place in Egypt:--Tahapanes, Tahpanhes, Tehaphnehes.

H8472.def: of Egyptian derivation; Tachpenes, an Egyptian woman:--Tahpenes.

H8473.et: from (02734) in the original sense of (02352) or (02353)
H8473.def: from «02734» in the original sense of «02352» or «02353»; a linen corslet (as white or hollow):--habergeon.

H8474.et: a facetious root from (02734) through the idea of the heat of jealousy
H8474.def: a facitious root from «02734» through the idea of the heat of jealousy; to vie with a rival:--close, contend.

H8476.def: probably of foreign derivation; a (clean) animal with fur, probably a species of antelope:--badger.

H8477.def: the same as «08476»; Tachash, a relative of Abraham:--Thahash.

H8478.def: from the same as «08430»; the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.:--as, beneath, × flat, in(-stead), (same) place (where...is), room, for...sake, stead of, under, × unto, × when...was mine, whereas, (where-)fore, with.

H8480.def: the same as «08478»; Tachath, the name of a place in the Desert, also of three Israelites:--Tahath.

H8482.def: from «08478»; lowermost; as noun (feminine plural) the depths (figuratively, a pit, the womb):--low (parts, -er, -er parts, - est), nether (part).

H8483.et: apparently from the pl. masc. of (08482) or (08478) and (02320)
H8483.def: apparently from the plural masculine of «08482» or «08478» and «02320»; lower (ones) monthly; Tachtim-Chodshi, a place in Palestine:--Tahtim-hodshi.

H8485.def: or Temao {tay-maw'}; probably of foreign derivation; Tema, a son of Ishmael, and the region settled by him:--Tema.

H8486.def: or teman {tay-mawn'}; denominative from «03225»; the south (as being on the right hand of a person facing the east):--south (side, -ward, wind).

H8487.def: or Teman {tay-mawn'}; the same as «08486»; Teman, the name of two Edomites, and of the region and descendant of one of them:--south, Teman.

H8489.def: patronymically from «08487»; a Temanite or descendant of Teman:--Temani, Temanite.

H8490.def: or timarah {tee-maw-raw'}; from the same as «08558»; a column, i.e. cloud:--pillar.

H8491.et: patrial or patronymically from an unused noun of uncertain meaning
H8491.def: patrial or patronymically from an unused noun of uncertain meaning; a Titsite or descendant or inhabitant of an unknown Tits:--Tizite.

H8492.et: from (03423) in the sense of expulsion
H8492.def: or tiyrosh {tee-roshe'}; from «03423» in the sense of expulsion; must or fresh grape-juice (as just squeezed out); by implication (rarely) fermented wine:--(new, sweet) wine.

H8493.def: probably from «03372»; fearful, Tirja, an Israelite:--Tiria.

H8494.def: probably of foreign derivation; Tiras, a son of Japheth:--Tiras.

H8495.et: from an unused root meaning to butt
H8495.def: from an unused root meaning to butt; a buck or he-goat (as given to butting):--he goat.

H8496.et: from the same base as (08432) (in the sense of cutting to pieces)
H8496.def: or towk (Psa. 72:14) {toke}; from the same base as «08432» (in the sense of cutting to pieces); oppression:--deceit, fraud.

H8497.def: a primitive root; to strew, i.e. encamp:--sit down.

H8498.def: feminine passive participle of «08505»; adjustment, i.e. structure; by implication, equipage:--fashion, store.

H8499.pos:
1. arrangement, preparation, fixed place, seat, place
    1. arrangement, disposition
    2. preparation
    3. fixed place, seat, place
H8499.def: from «03559»; or probably ident. with «08498»; something arranged or fixed, i.e. a place:--seat.
